exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on a bench and place one foot on the floor, the other leg crossed over your knee. 2. Position a dumbbell on your upper leg above the knee. 3. Press through the ball of your foot to raise your heel as high as possible. 4. Lower with control. Keep your back straight and work one leg at a time.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward. 2. Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are nearly extended. 3. Lower them back to shoulder height with control. 4. Engage your core and avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. 2. Elevate your shoulders toward your ears as high as possible, keeping arms straight. 3. Hold briefly at the top, then lower back down. 4. Keep the movement controlled and avoid rotating your shoulders forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
exercises.instructions: This exercise involves holding a dumbbell in one hand and bending sideways to work the oblique muscles on the side of the body. It can be done standing or seated and is often used as a core strengthening exercise.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat, keeping your chest up. 3. Push through your heels to return to standing. 4. Keep your knees tracking over your toes and maintain a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat To A Bench
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, position yourself in front of a bench. 2. Lower into a squat until you lightly touch the bench, then drive back up. 3. The bench acts as a depth guide. 4. Keep your chest up, knees over toes, and core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step Ups
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, stand facing a bench or step. 2. Step up with one leg, pressing through that heel to bring your body up. 3. Step back down and repeat, then alternate legs. 4. Keep your chest upright and avoid leaning forward into the step.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Extension -Pronated Grip
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold one dumbbell vertically with both hands, palms facing up from below. 2. Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping upper arms stationary. 3. Extend your elbows to press the dumbbell back up. 4. Maintain an upright posture and keep elbows fixed in place.

exercises.name: Elbow to Knee
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with hands behind your head, knees bent. 2. Crunch up and drive one knee toward the opposite elbow. 3. Return and repeat on the other side. 4. Move with control and avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: Elevated Back Lunge
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with one foot elevated on a bench behind you, holding a barbell across your shoulders. 2. Lower your front leg into a lunge until your front knee reaches 90 degrees. 3. Press through the front heel to return to standing. 4. Keep your torso upright and back knee straight down, not forward.

exercises.name: Elevated Cable Rows
exercises.instructions: 1. Set cable at mid-chest height and stand slightly elevated on a box. 2. Row the cable toward your torso, pulling elbows back and squeezing your lats. 3. Extend your arms forward with control. 4. Keep your chest high and avoid excessive torso rotation.

exercises.name: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.instructions: 1. Step onto the elliptical and position your feet on the pedals. 2. Maintain a steady, moderate to high pace that elevates your heart rate for the target duration. 3. Use your arms to drive the motion naturally with the pedals. 4. Maintain upright posture and keep a consistent rhythm throughout.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Crunch
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on an exercise ball with feet flat on the floor, ball positioned mid-back. 2. Cross your arms over your chest and crunch forward, bringing your ribs toward your hips. 3. Lower back to the starting position with control. 4. Avoid pulling on your neck and maintain stable feet throughout.

exercises.name: Exercise Ball Pull-In
exercises.instructions: 1. Start in a plank position with your shins on an exercise ball, hands directly under shoulders. 2. Roll the ball toward you by drawing your knees toward your chest. 3. Roll back out to the plank position. 4. Keep your hips level and core tight throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back on the floor with one kettlebell next to your chest, elbow bent. 2. Press the kettlebell upward and slightly forward until your arm is extended. 3. Lower with control back to the starting position. 4. Keep your core braced and avoid arching your lower back off the floor.

exercises.name: External Rotation
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your side holding a light dumbbell with your upper arm against your ribs, elbow bent 90 degrees. 2. Rotate the dumbbell upward by lifting your forearm away from your body. 3. Return to the starting position with control. 4. Keep your elbow pinned to your side and move only at the shoulder joint.

exercises.name: External Rotation with Band
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with a resistance band anchored at elbow height on your side. 2. Hold the other end with your elbow bent 90 degrees, arm against your torso. 3. Rotate your forearm outward against the band resistance. 4. Keep your elbow stationary and control the return movement.

exercises.name: External Rotation with Cable
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand sideways to a cable machine with handle at elbow height, elbow bent 90 degrees. 2. Rotate your forearm outward away from your body against cable tension. 3. Return to the starting position with control. 4. Maintain a bent elbow throughout and avoid moving your arm away from your side.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding an EZ-bar with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. 2. Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping them at your sides. 3. Lower the bar with control to full arm extension. 4. Avoid using momentum or swinging your torso.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ-bar above your chest with arms extended. 2. Lower the bar by bending your elbows, bringing it toward your forehead. 3. Extend your elbows to press the bar back up. 4. Keep your elbows stationary and in line with your shoulders.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: 1. Set a cable machine with the rope attachment at head height. 2. Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high and wide, splitting the rope at the finish. 3. Extend your arms forward with control. 4. Keep your core tight and avoid leaning backward.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
exercises.instructions: 1. Pick up heavy dumbbells and hold them at your sides with a firm grip, standing upright. 2. Walk forward in a straight line maintaining stable shoulders and neutral spine. 3. Complete your desired distance or time, then set the weights down. 4. Keep your shoulders stable and resist excessive trunk rotation.

exercises.name: Finger Curls
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit and drape a barbell across your thighs, hands palm-up with fingers only curling over the bar. 2. Curl only your fingers upward, lifting the bar slightly. 3. Lower back down by extending your fingers. 4. Keep your wrists straight and forearms flat on your thighs.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench between two cable stations set to mid-chest height. 2. Pull the cables together in an arc motion, bringing your hands to meet at your chest. 3. Open your arms back out to the sides with control. 4. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows and avoid clamping the cables together.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench, hands gripping the sides near your head. 2. Draw your knees toward your chest in a controlled motion. 3. Extend your legs back out, stopping just short of full extension. 4. Keep your lower back on the bench and use core tension to control the movement.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench with hands gripping the edge behind your head. 2. Raise your straight legs up toward the ceiling until they reach 90 degrees. 3. Lower them back down with control, just above the bench without touching. 4. Keep your lower back pressed into the bench and move slowly.

exercises.name: Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls
exercises.instructions: 1. Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and sit back with dumbbells hanging at your sides. 2. Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders, keeping elbows slightly back. 3. Lower them with control to full arm extension. 4. Let the incline stretch your biceps at the bottom and avoid using momentum.

exercises.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Kneel on a padded surface with someone holding your ankles down or your feet anchored. 2. Lower your body forward in a straight line from knees to head. 3. Use your hamstrings to return to upright, or catch yourself with your hands if needed. 4. Move with control and engage your hamstrings actively.

exercises.name: Floor Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back on the floor with a barbell on your chest, elbows bent 90 degrees. 2. Press the bar upward and slightly forward until your arms are extended. 3. Lower the bar back to chest level with control. 4. Your elbows will touch the floor at the bottom, limiting range of motion.

exercises.name: Floor Press with Chains
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on the floor with a barbell and chains loaded on it across your chest. 2. Press the bar upward; chains will progressively load as your arms extend. 3. Lower back down with control as chains release. 4. Maintain arm alignment and avoid moving your torso.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.instructions:
-Laying on the back, lift your straightened legs from the ground at a 45 degree angle.
-As your Left foot travels downward and nearly touches the floor, your Right foot should seek to reach a 90 degree angle, or as close to one as possible.
-Bring your R foot down until it nearly touches the floor, and bring your L foot upwards.  Maintain leg rigidity throughout the exercise.  Your head should stay off the ground, supported by tightened upper abdominals.
-(L up R down, L down R up, x2)  ^v, v^, ^v, v^ = 1 rep
-Primarily works the Rectus Abdominus, the hip flexors and the lower back. Secondarily works the Obliques.  Emphasis placed on the lower quadrant of the abs.

exercises.name: Forward Drag with Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a heavy object at chest height and drag it forward across the floor. 2. At the end of the drag, press the object away from you. 3. Return to the starting position. 4. Maintain core tension and control the dragging motion throughout.

exercises.name: Frankenstein Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a barbell at arm's length in front of your body with straight arms. 2. Squat down keeping your arms extended and body upright. 3. Drive through your heels to stand back up. 4. Keep your core braced and chest up; avoid leaning forward.

exercises.name: Freehand Jump Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hands on your chest or behind your head. 2. Lower into a squat and explosively jump up as high as possible. 3. Land softly and immediately lower into the next squat. 4. Keep your chest up and land with control, absorbing impact through your legs.

exercises.name: Frog Sit-Ups
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together, knees out to the sides in a butterfly position. 2. Sit up by curling your torso upward. 3. Lower back down with control. 4. Avoid pulling on your neck and let your abs drive the motion.

exercises.name: Front Barbell Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a barbell across the front of your shoulders with elbows high and forward. 2. Squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor. 3. Drive through your heels to return to standing. 4. Keep your torso upright, core braced, and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Front Barbell Squat To A Bench
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a barbell across your shoulders and position yourself in front of a bench. 2. Lower into a squat until you lightly touch the bench. 3. Drive back up to standing. 4. The bench provides depth control; keep your chest up and core engaged.

exercises.name: Front Cable Raise
exercises.instructions:
Raise the handle in a slight arc with controlled movement.
Don’t swing your torso to start the rep.

exercises.name: Front Dumbbell Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs with a neutral grip. 2. Raise the dumbbells up in front of you to eye level or just above. 3. Lower back down with control. 4. Maintain a slight elbow bend and avoid using momentum.

exercises.name: Front Incline Dumbbell Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and sit upright holding dumbbells at your thighs. 2. Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height. 3. Lower them back down with control. 4. The incline emphasizes front delts; keep a slight elbow bend throughout.

exercises.name: Front Plate Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding a weight plate vertically at chest height. 2. Raise the plate upward to eye level, leading with the top edge. 3. Lower back down with control. 4. Keep your core tight and avoid leaning backward.

exercises.name: Front Raise And Pullover
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your chest with arms extended. 2. Lower the bar in an arc behind your head, then pull it forward and up overhead. 3. Lower back to chest height. 4. Maintain control and avoid overextending your shoulder joint.

exercises.name: Front Squat (Clean Grip)
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a barbell in a clean grip with palms up and elbows high across your shoulders. 2. Squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor. 3. Drive through your heels to return to standing. 4. Keep your elbows high, chest up, and core engaged throughout.

exercises.name: Front Squats With Two Kettlebells
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold two kettlebells at shoulder height with elbows beneath your wrists. 2. Squat down keeping your chest up and knees tracking forward. 3. Drive through your heels to stand back up. 4. Maintain tight shoulders and neutral spine throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Front Two-Dumbbell Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs with palms facing inward. 2. Raise both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height, rotating palms down as you lift. 3. Lower back to the starting position. 4. Control the weight and avoid swinging at the hips.

exercises.name: Full Range-Of-Motion Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit at a lat pulldown machine and grip the bar wider than shoulder-width. 2. Pull the bar down to your chest by drawing your elbows down and back, feeling a stretch at the top. 3. Return with control to nearly full arm extension. 4. Maintain an upright torso and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: Gironda Sternum Chins
exercises.instructions: 1. Hang from a pull-up bar with hands slightly narrower than shoulder-width. 2. Pull your body upward, driving your elbows down and back, attempting to bring your sternum toward the bar. 3. Lower with control to full arm extension. 4. Keep your core tight and avoid excessive hip drive.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.instructions: Kneel on a glute-ham developer or have a partner hold your ankles. Keeping hips straight, lower your torso toward the floor under control, then curl back up by contracting the hamstrings and glutes.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions: 1. Start on your hands and knees with a neutral spine. 2. Drive one leg upward and backward, squeezing your glutes at the top. 3. Lower your leg back to the starting position. 4. Keep your core engaged and avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a kettlebell vertically at chest height with both hands cupping the top. 2. Squat down with an upright torso, knees driving outward. 3. Drive through your heels to return to standing. 4. The kettlebell helps balance; keep your chest up and core braced.

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.instructions: Stand with your feet more than shoulder-width apart (wider stance) and place your hands on your hips. Hinge at your hips and lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight then come back up.

exercises.name: Good Morning off Pins
exercises.instructions: 1. Rest a barbell across your shoulders with support pins set at or below your knees. 2. Hinge at the hips, lowering your torso forward while keeping your back neutral. 3. Drive your hips forward to stand back up. 4. Maintain a neutral spine and keep knees slightly bent.

exercises.name: Gorilla Chin/Crunch
exercises.instructions: 1. Hang from a pull-up bar with hands close together. 2. Crunch your knees up toward your chest while performing a small pull-up motion. 3. Lower your legs and release the pull-up. 4. Control the movement and maintain tension in your core.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Load the hack squat machine and position your shoulders under the pads, back against the angled sled. 2. Lower your body by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor. 3. Push through your heels to drive the weight back up. 4. Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.instructions:
Start: Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing your torso.
Curl: Lift the weights toward your shoulders while maintaining the neutral grip (like holding a hammer).
Squeeze: Contract the biceps at the top without moving your elbows forward.
Lower: Slowly return to the starting position with full control.

exercises.name: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie back holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing each other. 2. Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are nearly extended. 3. Lower with control back to shoulder height. 4. Keep your shoulders packed and chest engaged throughout.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Ups
exercises.instructions: 1. Kick up into a handstand against a wall with hands shoulder-width apart. 2. Lower your head toward the floor by bending your elbows. 3. Press yourself back up to the handstand position. 4. Keep your body tight and only move at the shoulder joint.

exercises.name: Hang Clean
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with a barbell just above your knees, feet hip-width apart. 2. Extend your hips explosively and shrug the bar up to chest height. 3. Quickly drop under the bar and catch it across your shoulders, standing up. 4. Use triple extension and catch in a stable position.

exercises.name: Hang Clean - Below the Knees
exercises.instructions: 1. Start with the barbell just below knee height, feet positioned hip-width apart. 2. Drive explosively through your legs and hips, shrugging the bar upward. 3. Move under the bar to catch it across your shoulders and stand. 4. Control your pull from the lower starting position and maintain balance.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with a barbell just above your knees, feet hip-width apart, hands in a wide snatch grip. 2. Extend explosively and shrug the bar upward, then pull yourself under it. 3. Catch the bar overhead with arms fully extended, standing up. 4. Keep the bar close to your body and use full-body extension.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch - Below Knees
exercises.instructions: 1. Start with the barbell just below knee height in a snatch grip. 2. Drive your legs and hips explosively, shrugging the bar up. 3. Move under the bar to catch it overhead in a stable position. 4. Control the pull from below the knees and catch with a solid stance.

exercises.name: Hanging Bar Good Morning
exercises.instructions: 1. Place a barbell across your shoulders while hanging from a pull-up bar, feet off the ground. 2. Hinge at your hips, allowing your torso to lower forward. 3. Drive your hips forward to return to an upright position. 4. Maintain a neutral spine and controlled movement throughout.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Hang from a pull-up bar with hands shoulder-width apart, legs straight. 2. Raise your straight legs up toward the ceiling until they reach 90 degrees. 3. Hold this position for the target duration, maintaining tension in your abs. 4. Avoid excessive swinging and keep the movement controlled.

exercises.name: Hanging Pike
exercises.instructions: 1. Hang from a pull-up bar in a straight-body plank position with your body aligned. 2. Pike your hips upward toward the ceiling in one smooth motion, bringing your legs up. 3. Maintain this pike position for the target duration. 4. Keep your core tight and control the hold without excessive swinging.

exercises.name: Heaving Snatch Balance
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding a barbell at shoulder height with feet hip-width apart, core braced. 2. Quickly dip by bending your knees a few inches while keeping your torso upright. 3. Explosively extend your legs to press the barbell overhead, locking your arms. 4. Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control. Keep your core tight throughout.

exercises.name: High Cable Curls
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand facing the machine with your arms at shoulder height, gripping the cable handles with elbows bent. 2. Curl your forearms downward, engaging your biceps against the cable tension. 3. Lower back up with control, keeping tension throughout. Focus on the mind-muscle connection with your biceps.

exercises.name: Hip Extension with Bands
exercises.instructions: 1. Place a resistance band around your glutes and anchor it securely. 2. Stand facing the anchor point, with slight knee bend, and extend one leg backward against the band resistance. 3. Return to starting position and squeeze your glutes at full extension. 4. Keep your core braced to prevent arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Hip Flexion with Band
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand facing the band anchor with the loop around one foot, legs straight. 2. Lift your knee forward and upward against the band, keeping your upper body still. 3. Lower your leg back down with control, maintaining band tension. Keep your standing leg straight and stable.

exercises.name: Hip Lift with Band
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with a band looped around your hips and anchored below your feet. 2. Drive your hips upward against the band resistance, squeezing your glutes at the top. 3. Lower back down with control. Press through your feet and keep your shoulders on the floor.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions (Back Extensions)
exercises.instructions: 1. Set up on a hyperextension bench with your hips on the pad and legs secure. 2. Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor. 3. Use your lower back and glutes to extend your hips and return to neutral. Keep your spine neutral—no excessive arching.

exercises.name: Hyperextensions With No Hyperextension Bench
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie face-down on a stability ball positioned under your hips. 2. Push through your feet to lift your torso upward, contracting your lower back. 3. Lower your torso back down with control. Keep your neck neutral and don't overarch your spine.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on an incline bench and hold a barbell above your chest with elbows slightly bent. 2. Lower the barbell in a controlled arc toward your forehead by bending your elbows. 3. Extend your elbows to press the bar back up, focusing on triceps engagement. Keep your elbows in a fixed position throughout.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Pull
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie face-down on an incline bench holding a barbell with shoulder-width grip. 2. Pull the barbell toward your lower chest, squeezing your traps and upper back. 3. Lower the bar back down with control. Keep your elbows slightly flared and chest on the bench.

exercises.name: Incline Cable Chest Press
exercises.instructions: Single arm chest press done with the cable machine. Use the other arm to brace bodyweight to focus on strength of the press, rather than balancing of the body. Start with the hand as close to the chest as possible, and then press against the cable at a slight incline and aiming towards the center of your chest.

exercises.name: Incline Cable Flye
exercises.instructions: 1. Set the pulleys high and stand in the middle with the bench set to incline. 2. Hold the cable handles with arms extended and chest facing the machine. 3. Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a hugging motion, squeezing your chest. 4. Return to the starting position with control. Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest height with palms facing inward. 2. Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward toward each other. 3. Lower the weights back to chest with control. Keep your shoulders packed and chest up.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions:
Setup: Set an adjustable bench to an incline of approximately 45 to 60 degrees.
Starting Position: Sit back against the bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor with your palms facing forward (supinated grip).
The Curl: Keeping your upper arms stationary and shoulders pinned back against the bench, exhale and curl the weights upward toward your shoulders.
Peak Contraction: Squeeze your biceps hard at the top of the movement, ensuring your elbows do not swing forward.
The Descent: Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, maintaining full control and feeling the stretch in the biceps.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells held above your chest, arms slightly bent. 2. Lower the dumbbells in a wide arc out to your sides as if hugging a tree. 3. Use your chest muscles to bring the weights back together at the top. Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes - With A Twist
exercises.instructions: 1. Set up on an incline bench and press dumbbells above your chest, then rotate your torso slightly. 2. Lower the weights in an arc while maintaining the rotated position, feeling chest stretch. 3. Press the dumbbells back up and rotate to neutral. Add rotation at the top to intensify chest engagement.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on an incline bench with dumbbells at shoulder height, feet flat on floor. 2. Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until arms nearly lock out. 3. Lower the weights back to shoulder height with control. Keep your shoulder blades retracted and core braced.

exercises.name: Incline Hammer Curls
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on an incline bench holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing each other. 2. Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, maintaining the neutral grip throughout. 3. Lower the weights back down with control. Keep your elbows stationary and focus on the biceps contraction.

exercises.name: Incline Inner Biceps Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on an incline bench with dumbbells at your sides, turning your pinkies slightly outward (supinated grip). 2. Curl the dumbbells upward, rotating your wrists to face forward at the top. 3. Lower back down with control, maintaining the supinated grip. This targets the inner head of the biceps.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.instructions: 1. Place your hands on an elevated surface with body in a straight line from head to heels. 2. Lower your body toward the surface by bending your elbows. 3. Push yourself back up to the starting position, squeezing your chest. Keep your core tight and body rigid.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Close-Grip
exercises.instructions: 1. Position your hands close together on an incline surface, body straight and aligned. 2. Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping them tucked near your torso. 3. Push back up powerfully, engaging your triceps throughout the movement. Keep your elbows close to your ribs.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Medium
exercises.instructions: 1. Place your hands on an incline at about shoulder-width apart, holding a straight body line. 2. Lower yourself with control by bending your elbows at a 45-degree angle. 3. Press back up with chest engagement. Keep your shoulders down and neck neutral throughout.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Reverse Grip
exercises.instructions: 1. Position hands on an incline surface with palms facing backward (reverse grip), body straight. 2. Lower yourself down by bending your elbows, maintaining reverse hand position. 3. Push back up forcefully to the starting position. This variation emphasizes chest from a different angle.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up Wide
exercises.instructions: 1. Place your hands on an incline surface wider than shoulder-width apart. 2. Lower your chest toward the surface with elbows flaring outward. 3. Push back up, squeezing your chest muscles at the top. Maintain a straight body alignment and engage your chest.

exercises.name: Internal Rotation with Band
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand sideways to the band anchor with your elbow bent at 90 degrees against your side. 2. Rotate your forearm toward your body against the band resistance. 3. Return to neutral position slowly. Keep your elbow pinned to your torso throughout.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Set a bar at hip height and grip it with straight arms, body angled beneath. 2. Pull your chest toward the bar by retracting your shoulder blades. 3. Lower yourself back to the starting position with control. Keep your body straight and core braced.

exercises.name: Inverted Row with Straps
exercises.instructions: 1. Adjust straps at hip height, grip them firmly with arms extended and body angled. 2. Pull your chest up to the handles by driving your elbows back and squeezing your traps. 3. Lower yourself down with control, maintaining tension. Keep your body rigid throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Iron Cross
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold dumbbells at your sides with your arms extended perpendicular to your body. 2. Press the dumbbells upward at a 45-degree angle toward the sky. 3. Lower the weights back down to shoulder height with control. Maintain a strong shoulder position and slight bend in elbows.

exercises.name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Front And Back
exercises.instructions: 1. Place your hand against your forehead and press your head forward against the resistance isometrically. 2. Hold this position for the prescribed duration, keeping tension steady. 3. Switch to the back of your head and press backward isometrically for the same duration. Don't let your head move—pure tension.

exercises.name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Sides
exercises.instructions: 1. Place your hand against the side of your head and push laterally with your neck against the resistance. 2. Maintain steady tension without any head movement for the duration. 3. Repeat on the opposite side with equal intensity. Focus on continuous tension without motion.

exercises.name: Isometric Wipers
exercises.instructions:
Assume push-up position, with hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Shift body weight as far as possible to one side, allowing the elbow on that side to flex.
Reverse the motion, moving completely over to the other side.
Return to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: Jackknife Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with legs and arms extended straight on the ground. 2. Simultaneously lift your torso and knees toward each other, folding at the hips. 3. Return to the extended position with control, engaging your abs throughout. Keep your lower back on the floor initially.

exercises.name: Janda Sit-Up
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet under a sturdy object or held down. 2. Curl your torso upward, leading with your sternum and engaging your abs. 3. Lower back down with control, maintaining tension in your abdominal muscles. Focus on pure abdominal contraction.

exercises.name: Jefferson Squats
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand in a staggered stance holding a barbell with one foot forward and one back. 2. Lower into a squat by bending both knees simultaneously. 3. Press through your front foot to return to standing. Keep your torso upright and weight balanced between legs.

exercises.name: Jerk Balance
exercises.instructions: 1. Start with the barbell at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart, core braced. 2. Dip quickly by bending your knees slightly while keeping the bar overhead. 3. Explosively extend your legs to stabilize the barbell overhead. Press your shoulders up without leg drive for balance.

exercises.name: Jerk Dip Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold the barbell at shoulder height, then dip down by bending your knees 45 degrees. 2. Drive explosively through your heels to propel yourself upward while pressing the bar overhead. 3. Descend into a quarter squat to stabilize the overhead position. Coordinate the dip and drive seamlessly.

exercises.name: JM Press
exercises.instructions: The JM press keeps your shoulders stationary, relying on the elbow flexion and extension to move the weight using your triceps strength. That means you get all the benefits of the best triceps-strengthening exercises without overtaxing that delicate shoulder joint. Classic win-win!

exercises.name: Jogging, Treadmill
exercises.instructions: 1. Set the treadmill to a comfortable pace and step on with upright posture. 2. Maintain a steady jogging rhythm, landing mid-foot and driving through your legs. 3. Hold for the prescribed duration or distance, keeping a consistent pace. Focus on steady breathing and knee drive.

exercises.name: Keg Load
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand facing a keg with a slight bend in your knees and arms ready to grip it. 2. Lift the keg by driving through your legs and extending your hips, securing it against your torso. 3. Return it to the ground with controlled descent. Engage your lower back and hamstrings on the lift.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a kettlebell at shoulder height with the handle at ear level, arm bent. 2. Press the kettlebell overhead while rotating your palm outward during the press. 3. Lower the kettlebell back to shoulder height by reversing the rotation. Keep your core braced and shoulders packed.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
exercises.instructions: 1. Place a kettlebell on the ground between your feet with a slight bend in your knees. 2. Explosively extend your hips and pull the kettlebell to shoulder height in one movement. 3. Control the kettlebell as it settles at shoulder height. Drive through your hamstrings and glutes on the pull.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Figure 8
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with knees slightly bent, holding a kettlebell by the handle. 2. Pass the kettlebell around one leg in a figure-8 pattern, switching hands underneath and behind. 3. Move smoothly through the pattern continuously for the prescribed reps. Keep your knees bent and core engaged.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a kettlebell upside down at chest height with both hands gripping the horns. 2. Circle the kettlebell around your head in a halo motion, following a large circular path. 3. Reverse direction and circle the opposite way. Move fluidly and keep the kettlebell close to your head.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo with Overhead Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Start with the kettlebell in halo position around your head. 2. Circle the kettlebell overhead while extending one arm fully at the top. 3. Lower and reverse the circle, alternating which arm extends. Combine mobility and strength in one dynamic movement.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Hang Clean
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with a kettlebell hanging in front of you between your legs with a slight bend. 2. Explosively extend your hips and pull the kettlebell to shoulder height. 3. Catch it at shoulder height with your arm bent. Drive power from your hips and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Kettlebell One-Legged Deadlift
exercises.instructions: This exercise involves holding a kettlebell in one hand and standing on one leg while bending forward to touch the kettlebell to the ground. It targets the hamstrings, glutes, and lower back while also improving balance and stability.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding a kettlebell overhead with both hands supporting the handle, arms extended. 2. Bend your elbows to lower the kettlebell behind your head in a controlled manner. 3. Extend your elbows to press the kettlebell back overhead. Keep your upper arms stationary and core braced.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pass Between The Legs
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with feet wide apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand in front of your hips. 2. Swing the kettlebell between your legs and pass it to the opposite hand behind you. 3. Swing it forward and pass it back to the starting hand in front. Move fluidly in a continuous figure-8 pattern.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pirate Ships
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a kettlebell at chest height with both hands, feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Rotate your torso side to side, moving the kettlebell across your body at chest height. 3. Maintain a strong core and controlled rotation throughout. Keep your hips stable and rotate from your core.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a kettlebell at chest height and stand on one leg with the other extended forward. 2. Lower into a single-leg squat by sitting back, using the kettlebell for balance. 3. Drive through your heel to return to standing. Keep your torso upright and core tight.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Seated Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit upright holding a kettlebell at shoulder height, core braced and back neutral. 2. Press the kettlebell overhead, fully extending your arm. 3. Lower the kettlebell back to shoulder height with control. Eliminate leg drive and focus on shoulder strength.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand holding two kettlebells at shoulder height in front of you. 2. Press one kettlebell overhead while the other stays at shoulder height, creating a seesaw motion. 3. Lower and alternate arms rhythmically, maintaining core tension. Alternate smoothly without pausing between presses.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
exercises.instructions:
A compound exercise combining elements of a sumo deadlift and a high pull. It targets the posterior chain, particularly the glutes, hamstrings, and upper back. The sumo stance increases hip engagement, while the high pull adds an explosive element, promoting power development.
Stand upright overtop of a kettlebell with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart angled out slightly.
Maintain a braced core and neutral spine throughout the exercise.
Hinge your hips backward and extend your arms to grab ahold the kettlebell with a double overhand grip.
With you lower legs nearly vertical to the ground, extend your hips to raise the kettlebell with your elbows high keeping it close to your body.
Once the kettlebell has reached shoulder height, lower back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Thruster
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a kettlebell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Perform a quarter squat, then explosively extend your legs while pressing the kettlebell overhead. 3. Lower the kettlebell back to shoulder height as you stand. Coordinate the squat and press into one fluid movement.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Lunge style)
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back holding a kettlebell overhead with one arm, opposite leg extended. 2. Roll to your elbow, then push up to a lunge position while keeping the kettlebell overhead. 3. Return to the starting position by reversing the movement. Move deliberately and keep the kettlebell stable overhead.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Squat style)
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back holding a kettlebell overhead with one arm, both legs bent. 2. Transition to a sitting position, then a squat position while maintaining overhead press. 3. Return to lying position by reversing the movement step-by-step. Stay controlled and keep eyes on the kettlebell.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Windmill
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with one kettlebell overhead in a locked-out position, feet wider than hip-width. 2. Hinge your hips and rotate your torso downward toward the opposite leg while keeping the kettlebell overhead. 3. Return to the starting position by reversing the movement. Maintain a strong core and stable shoulder throughout.

exercises.name: Kipping Muscle Up
exercises.instructions: 1. Hang from a pull-up bar with a slight bend in your arms. 2. Use a kipping motion by swinging your legs to generate momentum, then explosively pull and press yourself above the bar. 3. Lower yourself back to the hang position with control. Time your kipping swing with the pull and dip portion.

exercises.name: Knee/Hip Raise On Parallel Bars
exercises.instructions: 1. Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight and body hanging. 2. Lift your knees toward your chest or hips toward your hands, contracting your abs. 3. Lower back down to the starting position with control. Avoid swinging and maintain upright torso.

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists
exercises.instructions: 1. Kneel facing the cable machine with the rope attachment at neck height, holding it in front. 2. Crunch downward while rotating your torso to bring your elbow to the opposite knee. 3. Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side. Keep your hips stationary and focus on core engagement.

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Kneel facing the cable machine with the rope attachment at head height. 2. Extend your elbows downward against the cable resistance, engaging your triceps. 3. Bend your elbows to return to the starting position. Keep your torso upright and core engaged.

exercises.name: Kneeling High Pulley Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Kneel facing the cable machine, gripping the high pulley handle with both hands. 2. Pull the handle down and toward your chest, retracting your shoulder blades. 3. Return to the starting position with control. Maintain an upright torso and focus on lat engagement.

exercises.name: Kneeling Jump Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a barbell on your shoulders and kneel on one leg (or both knees depending on variation). 2. Explosively push through your front leg to jump and land softly back to kneeling position. 3. Repeat the explosive motion dynamically. Use your glutes and quads to generate power.

exercises.name: Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Kneel facing the cable machine with one arm extended toward the high pulley handle. 2. Pull the handle down to your chest while rotating your torso slightly toward the working side. 3. Control the return to the starting position. Focus on unilateral lat engagement and anti-rotation.

exercises.name: Kneeling Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a barbell on your shoulders and kneel on both knees, toes anchored to the floor. 2. Sink your hips toward your heels by bending at the knees deeply. 3. Drive through your knees to return to the starting position. Keep your torso upright and core braced.

exercises.name: Landmine 180's
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand at the end of a landmine setup holding the barbell handle with both hands at chest height. 2. Rotate your torso 180 degrees, swinging the barbell across your body. 3. Return to center and rotate to the opposite side. Use your core and obliques to drive the rotation.

exercises.name: Landmine Linear Jammer
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand at a 45-degree angle to the landmine with the barbell in both hands at shoulder height. 2. Press the barbell forward and upward in a diagonal line, extending your arms fully. 3. Pull the barbell back to shoulder height with control. Engage your shoulders and chest throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise - With Bands
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand on the resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Hold the band ends at shoulder height with a slight elbow bend. 3. Raise your arms out to the sides until level with your shoulders. 4. Lower back to start with control, maintaining tension on the delts.

exercises.name: Leg Extensions
exercises.instructions: The leg extension is a resistance weight training exercise that targets the quadriceps muscle in the legs. The exercise is done using a machine called the Leg Extension Machine. There are various manufacturers of these machines and each one is slightly different. Most gym and weight rooms will have the machine in their facility. The leg extension is an isolated exercise targeting one specific muscle group, the quadriceps. It should not be considered as a total leg workout, such as the squat or deadlift. The exercise consists of bending the leg at the knee and extending the legs, then lowering them back to the original position.

exercises.name: Leg Lift
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your side, supporting your head with your hand. 2. Stack your legs with the top leg straight. 3. Lift your top leg upward, squeezing your glutes. 4. Lower without touching the bottom leg. Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: The leg press is a weight training exercise in which the individual pushes a weight or resistance away from them using their legs.

exercises.name: Leg Pull-In
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with legs extended, or hang from a pull-up bar. 2. Pull your knees toward your chest in one smooth motion. 3. Extend your legs back out with control. 4. Keep your lower back from excessively arching.

exercises.name: Leg-Over Floor Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back holding a kettlebell at chest level. 2. Press the weight up and over your head in a smooth arc. 3. Lower it back down under control. 4. Maintain core tension to protect your lower back.

exercises.name: Leverage Chest Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit with your back firmly against the machine pad. 2. Grip handles at chest height. 3. Press forward explosively, fully extending your arms. 4. Bring handles back to chest with control.

exercises.name: Leverage Deadlift
exercises.instructions: 1. Position yourself in the machine with feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Grip the handles and keep your chest up. 3. Drive through your legs to extend fully, squeezing your quads. 4. Lower back down under control.

exercises.name: Leverage Decline Chest Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Recline on the decline pad with chest aligned to handles. 2. Press forward and up, extending your arms fully. 3. Bring handles back to chest with control. 4. Keep your shoulder blades retracted throughout.

exercises.name: Leverage High Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit upright gripping handles at shoulder height. 2. Pull toward your body, driving elbows high and back. 3. Squeeze your traps and upper back at the peak. 4. Return to start with controlled movement.

exercises.name: Leverage Incline Chest Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit with your back against the inclined pad, hands on handles. 2. Press forward and up, extending fully. 3. Bring handles back to chest with control. 4. Keep your core stable against the pad.

exercises.name: Leverage Iso Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit upright facing the machine with feet firm on the platform. 2. Grasp handles and row them toward your torso. 3. Drive elbows back, squeezing your lats and middle back. 4. Return smoothly to start position.

exercises.name: Leverage Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit upright with handles at shoulder height. 2. Press upward and slightly forward until arms fully extend. 3. Lower back to shoulder level with control. 4. Keep your core braced for stability.

exercises.name: Leverage Shrug
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit upright and grip handles with a neutral grip. 2. Elevate your shoulders toward your ears as high as possible. 3. Pause briefly at the top. 4. Lower back down, avoiding neck hunching.

exercises.name: Log Lift
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold the log at chest height with feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Drive the log upward and press it overhead explosively. 3. Lower back to chest under control. 4. Engage your core and keep the log stable.

exercises.name: London Bridges
exercises.instructions: 1. Position yourself to engage the apparatus with your lats. 2. Execute a controlled pulling or rowing motion with full body engagement. 3. Return to the starting position. 4. Maintain core tension and spinal stability throughout.

exercises.name: Low Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand in the middle of the cable machine with feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Grab each handle with a slight elbow bend. 3. Bring your hands together in front of you in a crossing motion. 4. Return to start with control, maintaining the arc.

exercises.name: Low Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand facing away from the cable stack with rope or bar attachment. 2. Position upper arms at your sides with elbows bent 90 degrees. 3. Extend your forearms downward, pressing through your triceps. 4. Return to start with control.

exercises.name: Low Pulley Row To Neck
exercises.instructions: 1. Set cable to low position and grip the handle. 2. Row the cable upward toward your neck, driving elbows high. 3. Squeeze your rear delts and upper back at the top. 4. Return to start with control.

exercises.name: Lunge Pass Through
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a kettlebell at chest height, standing upright. 2. Step forward into a lunge, passing the weight to the other side. 3. Return to standing and repeat on the opposite leg. 4. Keep your torso upright and core engaged.

exercises.name: Lunge Sprint
exercises.instructions: 1. Establish a lunge position in the machine with one leg forward. 2. Drive through the front leg to extend and stand up. 3. Step back into a lunge on the opposite side in a continuous motion. 4. Keep your chest up and core braced.

exercises.name: Lying Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on an incline bench with cable positioned behind you. 2. Grab the cable handle with arms extended. 3. Curl the weight toward you, squeezing your biceps at the top. 4. Lower under control, maintaining tension.

exercises.name: Lying Cambered Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie prone on a decline bench or floor. 2. Hold the cambered barbell with a wide grip. 3. Row the barbell up toward your chest, driving elbows back. 4. Lower the bar with control, avoiding jerky movements.

exercises.name: Lying Close-Grip Bar Curl On High Pulley
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie under a high cable pulley with bar at arm's length above you. 2. Use a close grip to curl the bar down toward your chest. 3. Squeeze your biceps at the bottom. 4. Return to start position with control.

exercises.name: Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Extension Behind The Head
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench holding a close-grip barbell above your chest. 2. Lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows. 3. Keep elbows stable at a fixed angle. 4. Press back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Press To Chin
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a bench with the EZ bar held above your chest. 2. Lower the bar toward your chin by bending your elbows. 3. Keep elbows tucked at a 45-degree angle. 4. Press back up to the start position.

exercises.name: Lying Dumbbell Tricep Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell held at arm's length above your chest. 2. Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell toward your forehead or behind your head. 3. Keep elbows fixed and stable. 4. Press back up to the start.

exercises.name: Lying Face Down Plate Neck Resistance
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie face down on a bench with your head hanging slightly off the edge. 2. Position a plate on the back of your head. 3. Raise your head upward against the resistance. 4. Lower back down with deliberate control for neck safety.

exercises.name: Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your head slightly off the end of a bench. 2. Place a plate on your forehead. 3. Raise your head upward against the resistance. 4. Lower back down with careful control for neck protection.

exercises.name: Lying High Bench Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a high incline bench with the barbell held at arm's length. 2. Curl the barbell upward toward your shoulders. 3. Squeeze your biceps at the top. 4. Lower the barbell with full control back to start.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curls
exercises.instructions: The leg curl, also known as the hamstring curl, is an isolation exercise that targets the hamstring muscles. The exercise involves flexing the lower leg against resistance towards the buttocks. Other exercises that can be used to strengthen the hamstrings are the glute-ham raise and the deadlift.

exercises.name: Lying Machine Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie back in the machine with feet on platform, knees at 90 degrees. 2. Press through your feet to extend your legs fully. 3. Lower back down under control without locking your knees. 4. Keep your lower back neutral against the pad.

exercises.name: Lying One-Arm Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your side on a bench with a dumbbell in your upper hand. 2. Raise the dumbbell up and slightly forward in an arc. 3. Squeeze your shoulder at the top. 4. Lower back down with control.

exercises.name: Lying Rear Delt Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells in each hand. 2. Raise your arms out to the sides and slightly back. 3. Squeeze your rear delts at the top. 4. Lower back down under control.

exercises.name: Lying Supine Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with dumbbells in each hand, arms extended upward. 2. Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders by bending your elbows. 3. Squeeze your biceps at the top. 4. Lower back to start with control.

exercises.name: Lying T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Position yourself prone on the T-bar machine with your chest on the pad. 2. Grip the handles with a neutral or wide grip. 3. Row the handles toward you, squeezing your middle back. 4. Return to start under control.

exercises.name: Lying Triceps Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench holding the EZ bar above your chest at arm's length. 2. Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending your elbows. 3. Keep your elbows stable. 4. Press back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Machine Bench Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit upright on the machine with your back firmly against the pad. 2. Grip handles at chest height. 3. Press forward explosively, extending your arms fully. 4. Return to start with controlled movement.

exercises.name: Machine Bicep Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit with your back against the pad and forearms on the machine's arm pad. 2. Grip the handles and curl upward toward your shoulders. 3. Squeeze your biceps at the top. 4. Lower back down under control.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curls
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit at the preacher bench, positioning your triceps on the pad. 2. Grip the bar with a shoulder-width grip. 3. Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders. 4. Lower back down with control, maintaining contact with the pad.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder (Military) Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit upright with your back and head against the support pad. 2. Position handles at shoulder height on each side. 3. Press upward and slightly forward until your arms fully extend. 4. Lower back to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Machine Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit upright at the machine with your back against the pad. 2. Position your upper arms on the armrests with elbows bent. 3. Extend your forearms downward, straightening your arms. 4. Return to start with control.

exercises.name: Middle Back Shrug
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides. 2. Shrug your shoulders upward toward your ears. 3. Squeeze your traps and upper back at the top. 4. Lower your shoulders back down with control.

exercises.name: Mixed Grip Chin
exercises.instructions: 1. Hang from a bar with one hand in overhand grip, one underhand. 2. Pull your body upward using your lats and upper back. 3. Lift until your chest nears the bar. 4. Lower yourself back down under control.

exercises.name: Monster Walk
exercises.instructions: 1. Place a resistance band around your legs just above your knees. 2. Stand with feet hip-width apart in a partial squat. 3. Take a step forward, maintaining squat and band tension. 4. Continue walking forward with glutes engaged and core tight.

exercises.name: Muscle Snatch
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the barbell on the ground at your feet. 2. Bend your knees and hips with your back straight to grip the bar. 3. Explosively extend your hips, knees, ankles, pulling the bar upward and pressing it overhead. 4. Lower the bar back to start with control.

exercises.name: Muscle Up
exercises.instructions:
The body is then explosively pulled up by the arms in a radial pull-up, with greater speed than a regular pull-up. When the bar approaches the upper chest, the wrists are swiftly flexed to bring the forearms above the bar. The body is leaned forward, and the elbows are straightened by activating the triceps. The routine is considered complete when the bar is at the level of the waist and the arms are fully straight.
To dismount, the arms are bent at the elbow, and the body is lowered to the floor, and the exercise can be repeated.
As a relatively advanced exercise, muscle-ups are typically first learned with an assistive kip. The legs swing (kip) up and provide momentum to assist in the explosive upward force needed to ascend above the bar. More advanced athletes can perform a strict variation of the muscle-up which is done slowly, without any kip. This variation begins with a still dead hang and uses isometric muscle contraction to ascend above the bar in a slow, controlled fashion.

exercises.name: Narrow Stance Hack Squats
exercises.instructions: 1. Position yourself in the hack squat machine with feet close together. 2. Keep your back and head against the pad. 3. Lower your body down by bending your knees. 4. Drive through your heels to extend back to standing, keeping knees aligned.

exercises.name: Narrow Stance Leg Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit in the leg press machine with feet close together on the platform. 2. Keep your back and head against the pad. 3. Lower the weight by bending your knees to about 90 degrees. 4. Drive through your heels to press back up without locking your knees.

exercises.name: Narrow Stance Squats
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a barbell across your upper back with feet close together. 2. Lower your body down by bending your knees and hips. 3. Keep your chest up and core engaged. 4. Drive through your heels to stand back up, avoiding excessive forward knee drift.

exercises.name: Natural Glute Ham Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Kneel on a pad with your knees anchored or feet secured. 2. Lower your body forward by hinging at the knees. 3. Catch yourself on your hands briefly if needed. 4. Press back to kneeling using your hamstrings and glutes.

exercises.name: Neck Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench with the barbell at neck level across your upper chest. 2. Press the barbell upward and slightly forward. 3. Extend your arms fully at the top. 4. Lower the bar back to your neck with deliberate control.

exercises.name: Oblique Crunches
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor. 2. Place your hands behind your head or crossed on your chest. 3. Crunch upward, rotating your torso toward one side. 4. Lower and alternate sides, keeping your lower back flat.

exercises.name: Oblique Crunches - On The Floor
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent. 2. Place your hands behind your head lightly. 3. Crunch upward while rotating your torso toward one side. 4. Lower back down and alternate sides, pressing lower back into floor.

exercises.name: Olympic Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, barbell on your upper back. 2. Push your hips back and bend your knees together to initiate descent. 3. Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground or deeper. 4. Drive through your heels to stand back up with a tight core.

exercises.name: One Arm Chin-Up
exercises.instructions: 1. Hang from a bar using one hand grip. 2. Pull your body upward, creating a pulling motion with one arm to engage your lats. 3. Raise your body toward the bar. 4. Lower yourself back down under control. Use assistance if needed.

exercises.name: One Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in one hand at chest height. 2. Press the dumbbell upward and slightly inward. 3. Extend your arm fully without locking your elbow. 4. Lower back to chest level with control, keeping your torso stable.

exercises.name: One Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit at a preacher bench with your triceps resting on the pad. 2. Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your arm extended. 3. Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder. 4. Squeeze your biceps at the top, then lower with control.

exercises.name: One Arm Floor Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back on the floor holding a barbell with one arm. 2. Press the barbell upward from chest level. 3. Extend your arm fully without locking your elbow. 4. Lower back to your chest, keeping your core engaged.

exercises.name: One Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit at a lat pulldown machine, gripping one handle with one arm. 2. Pull the handle downward and toward your torso, driving your elbow down. 3. Squeeze your lat at the bottom. 4. Return to start with controlled movement.

exercises.name: One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand upright holding a dumbbell overhead with one arm, palm facing forward. 2. Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow. 3. Keep your upper arm stationary. 4. Press the dumbbell back to the starting position.

exercises.name: One Arm Supinated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand upright holding a dumbbell overhead with one arm, palm facing inward. 2. Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow. 3. Keep your upper arm vertical and stationary. 4. Press the dumbbell back overhead with control.

exercises.name: One Leg Barbell Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand on one leg while holding a barbell across your upper back. 2. Lower your body down on your working leg only, bending your knee. 3. Keep your torso upright and core braced. 4. Drive through your working leg to stand back up. Use light weight for balance.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Place one knee on a bench, holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand. 2. Row the dumbbell up toward your hip, driving your elbow back. 3. Squeeze your traps and middle back at the top. 4. Lower the dumbbell back down under control.

exercises.name: One-Arm Flat Bench Dumbbell Flye
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie flat on a bench with one dumbbell held above your chest, arm nearly straight. 2. Lower the dumbbell in a wide arc across your body, keeping a slight elbow bend. 3. Return to the starting position, squeezing your chest. Maintain control and avoid bouncing the weight.

exercises.name: One-Arm High-Pulley Cable Side Bends
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand beside a cable machine with the high pulley set, holding the handle at shoulder height. 2. Side bend away from the machine, feeling your obliques contract. 3. Return to upright position, keeping your torso stable. Don't rotate or twist your shoulders.

exercises.name: One-Arm Incline Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on an incline bench angled at 45 degrees, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side. 2. Raise the dumbbell out to the side until your arm reaches shoulder height. 3. Lower it back down with control, maintaining a slight elbow bend. Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the kettlebell on the ground between your feet. 2. Hip hinge, grip the kettlebell, and explosively extend your hips while raising it to shoulder height. 3. Catch it with a slight bend, then lower it for the next rep. Keep your core tight and spine neutral.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean and Jerk
exercises.instructions: 1. Clean the kettlebell to shoulder height in one powerful movement from the ground. 2. Dip your knees slightly, then drive through your legs to press it overhead. 3. Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the ground. Move explosively through your entire body.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat, kettlebell at chest level. 2. Press the kettlebell straight up, fully extending your arm. 3. Lower it back to your chest under control. Keep your core engaged and lower back pressed into the floor.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Jerk
exercises.instructions: 1. Start with the kettlebell racked at shoulder height. 2. Dip your knees and explosively drive up, pressing the kettlebell overhead as you dip under it. 3. Return to standing, bringing the kettlebell back to your shoulder. Move explosively from your hips.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press To The Side
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the kettlebell racked at shoulder height, feet staggered. 2. Press the kettlebell overhead and slightly away from your body at an angle. 3. Lower it back to shoulder height under control. Keep your core tight and avoid excessive arching.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Para Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand in a lunge position with the kettlebell held at shoulder height. 2. Press the kettlebell diagonally overhead, front and to the side. 3. Return to shoulder height, maintaining your stance. Engage your core to prevent rotation.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Push Press
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the kettlebell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Dip your knees slightly, then explosively drive up while pressing the kettlebell overhead. 3. Lower it back to shoulder height under control. Use your legs to generate power.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Hinge at the hips with the kettlebell hanging at arm's length, knees slightly bent. 2. Row the kettlebell up, driving your elbow back and squeezing your upper back and traps. 3. Lower it with control. Keep your torso stable and avoid rotating your shoulders.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Snatch
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the kettlebell on the ground between your feet. 2. Explosively pull it from the ground, guiding it overhead in one fluid motion. 3. Absorb the weight overhead with a slight bend, then lower it for the next rep. Keep your core braced throughout.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Split Jerk
exercises.instructions: 1. Start with the kettlebell racked at shoulder height. 2. Dip your knees, then explosively press the kettlebell overhead while splitting your feet into a staggered stance. 3. Return to standing, then lower to your shoulder. Drive power from your legs.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Split Snatch
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the kettlebell on the ground. 2. In one explosive movement, pull it overhead while splitting your feet into a lunge position. 3. Return to standing with the kettlebell overhead, then lower it for the next rep. Catch overhead with control.

exercises.name: One-Arm Kettlebell Swings
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the kettlebell on the ground between your feet, feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Hinge at the hips, grab it, and explosively drive your hips forward to swing it to shoulder height. 3. Let it swing back and repeat. Generate power from your hips, not your arms.

exercises.name: One-Arm Long Bar Row
exercises.instructions: 1. Load one end of a barbell into a corner; stand in front straddling the bar. 2. Grip the free end and row it to your chest, driving your elbow back powerfully. 3. Lower the barbell under control. Keep your torso stable and squeeze your traps at the top.

exercises.name: One-Arm Medicine Ball Slam
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the medicine ball overhead, feet shoulder-width apart, core braced. 2. Explosively slam the ball to the ground in front of you, extending through your core and shoulders. 3. Catch the bounce and return overhead. Drive through your entire body.

exercises.name: One-Arm Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the kettlebell on the ground, preparing an open palm grip. 2. Explosively extend your hips to lift the kettlebell to shoulder height. 3. Lower it back to the ground. This requires precise hand positioning and control.

exercises.name: One-Arm Overhead Kettlebell Squats
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold the kettlebell overhead with one arm fully extended, feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Squat down while keeping the weight locked overhead and your core braced. 3. Drive through your heels to stand back up. Maintain shoulder stability throughout.

exercises.name: One-Arm Side Deadlift
exercises.instructions: 1. Load one side of a barbell; stand with it between your feet, shoulder-width apart. 2. Hinge at the hips and pull the barbell off the ground to hip height, extending your legs. 3. Lower it back under control. Avoid rotating your torso.

exercises.name: One-Arm Side Laterals
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with a dumbbell at your side, feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend. 3. Lower it back to your side under control. Minimize leg drive and momentum.

exercises.name: One-Legged Cable Kickback
exercises.instructions: 1. Face a cable machine, one foot on a platform for stability, with the cable strap around one ankle. 2. Kick your free leg backward, squeezing your glute at full extension. 3. Return your leg to the starting position with control. Keep your hips square throughout.

exercises.name: Open Palm Kettlebell Clean
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the kettlebell on the ground, preparing an open palm grip without closing your fingers. 2. Explosively extend your hips and pull the kettlebell to shoulder height. 3. Lower it back to the ground under control. This demands balance and hand strength.

exercises.name: Otis-Up
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat; hold a weight to your chest. 2. Perform a sit-up, then rotate your torso to one side at the top. 3. Lower yourself back down. This combines flexion and rotation for complete core engagement.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Position yourself under a cable machine with the pulley set high; grab the bar with elbows at shoulder height. 2. Curl the cable toward your forehead, keeping your elbows stationary. 3. Lower it back with control. Squeeze your biceps at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat
exercises.instructions: The barbell is held overhead in a wide-arm snatch grip; however, it is also possible to use a closer grip if balance allows.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.instructions:
The Pallof press is an anti-rotation exercise that trains the larger and smaller muscles around the spine to resist rotation.
Stand parallel to the cable machine or to the anchor point to the
resistance band and clasp with the handle or band with both hands.
Make sure your torso is front on and bring your hands to the center of your chest and slowly press out.
Slowly return your hands to the chest and repeat.

exercises.name: Pallof Press With Rotation
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand perpendicular to a cable machine with the handle at chest height; pull it in front of your chest. 2. Press the cable forward while resisting rotation, then rotate your torso to face the machine. 3. Return to center and bring the cable back to your chest. Brace your core throughout.

exercises.name: Palms-Down Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your forearms resting on your thighs, palms down, holding dumbbells. 2. Lower the dumbbells by dropping your wrists downward in a controlled manner. 3. Raise them back up by extending your wrists. Keep movement isolated to your forearms.

exercises.name: Palms-Down Wrist Curl Over A Bench
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your forearms resting on your thighs, palms down, holding a barbell. 2. Lower the barbell by bending your wrists downward. 3. Raise it back up by extending your wrists. Perform slowly for maximum forearm engagement.

exercises.name: Palms-Up Barbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your forearms on your thighs, palms up, holding a barbell. 2. Curl the barbell upward by flexing your wrists. 3. Lower it back down under control. Keep your forearms still throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Palms-Up Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit on a bench with your forearms resting on your thighs, palms up, holding dumbbells. 2. Curl the dumbbells upward by flexing your wrists. 3. Lower them back down under control. Minimize movement outside your wrists.

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Dip
exercises.instructions: 1. Grasp parallel bars with your arms straight and body suspended. 2. Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the ground. 3. Push back up to the starting position. Keep your torso upright and engage your triceps.

exercises.name: Physioball Hip Bridge
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet on a stability ball, knees bent, hips off the ground. 2. Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes, forming a bridge. 3. Lower your hips back down under control. Keep your core engaged throughout.

exercises.name: Pin Presses
exercises.instructions: 1. Set safety pins in a power rack at chest height with a barbell loaded. 2. Press the barbell from the pins to full arm extension. 3. Lower it back to the pins. This emphasizes the pressing motion without the stretch phase.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions:
Get into a position on the floor supporting your weight on your forearms and toes. Arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty an arm or leg can be raised while performing this exercise.

exercises.name: Plate Pinch
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold two weight plates together with one hand, flat side out and smooth surfaces facing your palm. 2. Squeeze the plates together firmly for time. 3. Rest and repeat. Focus on grip strength and finger engagement.

exercises.name: Plate Twist
exercises.instructions: 1. Hold a weight plate at chest level with both hands, keeping your arms bent. 2. Rotate your torso side to side, pivoting from your core. 3. Return to center after each rotation. Keep your legs still and core braced.

exercises.name: Platform Hamstring Slides
exercises.instructions: 1. Lie on your back with your feet on a slippery platform, knees bent. 2. Curl your feet toward your glutes by engaging your hamstrings. 3. Extend your legs back to the starting position under control. Perform slowly and deliberately.

exercises.name: Plie Dumbbell Squat
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out, holding a dumbbell at your chest. 2. Squat down, keeping your torso upright and knees tracking over your toes. 3. Drive through your heels to stand back up. Squeeze your quads and glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Plyo Kettlebell Pushups
exercises.instructions: 1. Position yourself in a push-up stance with hands on kettlebells. 2. Lower into a push-up, then explosively drive up, releasing your hands briefly. 3. Catch yourself back on the kettlebells. This combines chest strength and explosive power.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.instructions: Olympic weight lifting

exercises.name: Power Clean from Blocks
exercises.instructions: 1. Set the barbell on blocks at knee height. 2. Explosively pull the barbell from the blocks to shoulder height in one powerful movement. 3. Lower it back to the blocks. Start lighter and focus on explosive hip extension.

exercises.name: Power Jerk
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the barbell racked at shoulder height. 2. Dip your knees, then explosively drive up while pressing the barbell overhead and stepping into a staggered stance. 3. Return to standing with the barbell overhead. Use your entire body to generate power.

exercises.name: Power Partials
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with dumbbells at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Press the dumbbells upward through a partial range of motion. 3. Lower them back to your shoulders. This emphasizes the top portion of the shoulder press.

exercises.name: Power Snatch
exercises.instructions: 1. Stand with the barbell on the ground, feet shoulder-width apart. 2. Explosively pull the barbell from the ground to overhead in one fluid motion. 3. Lower it back to the ground under control. Keep the bar close to your body throughout.

exercises.name: Power Snatch from Blocks
exercises.instructions: 1. Set the barbell on blocks at knee height. 2. Explosively pull the barbell from the blocks to overhead in one movement. 3. Lower it back to the blocks. This reduces range and emphasizes the explosive pull.

exercises.name: Power Stairs
exercises.instructions: 1. Ascend a set of stairs at a moderate, sustainable pace. 2. Maintain steady breathing and continuous movement up the stairs. 3. Reach the top and control your breathing. This builds lower body power and conditioning.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions: 1. Sit at a preacher curl bench with the barbell resting on the pad, arms extended. 2. Curl the barbell up toward your shoulders by flexing your biceps. 3. Lower it back to the pad under control. Keep your upper arms in contact with the pad.

exercises.name: Preacher Hammer Dumbbell Curl
